# pidginhost_private_network (Resource)

A private network that cloud servers join with pidginhost_private_network_member.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_private_network" "backend" {
  address = "198.51.100.0/24"
  gateway = "198.51.100.1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Network in CIDR notation, such as 198.51.100.0/24. Changing it replaces the network.

### Optional

- `gateway` (String) Gateway address on the network.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object in the PidginHost API.
- `provisioned` (Boolean) Whether the API has finished setting up the network.
- `slug` (String) Network in CIDR notation as the API names it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a private network by its ID.
terraform import pidginhost_private_network.backend 12345
```
